desc:
Update 8/7/2026
Overhauled networking code. Expect fast gameplay with zero delays. 
Implemented new weapon system. Characters with built in weapons can now use them.

Console Controls:
Y- Open settings / Choose Character
B - First Transformation
X - Second Transformation
L1 - Toggle flight
L2 - Dodge roll
A - Jump (Press twice in air for Dodge Roll)
Left Stick - Walk/Run

Computer Controls:
T - First Transformation, 
E - Second Transformation
Robot mode Specific: 
Q - Dodge Roll
Y - Activate Drill
F - Block Attack (Toggle)
Caps Lock - Attack
Shift - Toggle Run / Walk
Vehicle mode Specific:
Mouse Left Click - Fly
Mouse Right Click - Move Camera

Bug reporting, suggestions and character requests:
https://www.roblox.com/communities/13621325/Cybertrons
